title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Sunday, 4 October 2026
description: Today's stories: Google DeepMind's new SynthID Bio watermarking system for AI-designed proteins, NRL and NRLW grand final day in Sydney alongside the start of daylight saving, the final stretch of Queensland's King's Birthday long weekend, and calm boating conditions on the Gold Coast as BLEACH Festival continues. 오늘의 브리핑은 영어에 이어 한국어로도 제공됩니다.
